title: Keg Pressure Leak Overnight
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kegerator:pressure
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=0 AND hour<6
| bin _time span=1d
| stats first(psi) as start_psi, last(psi) as end_psi by keg _time
| eval overnight_drop_psi=round(start_psi-end_psi,1)
| where overnight_drop_psi>3
| sort - overnight_drop_psi
description: Uses Kegerator pressure telemetry telemetry to monitor overnight pressure loss from each keg in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for gas leaks before they flatten a batch, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Kegerator pressure telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily keg table of overnight pressure drop.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals overnight pressure loss from each keg so you can spot gas leaks before they flatten a batch before it becomes annoying.
